evidence: Implements validation rules for BIP 54 Consensus Cleanup across src/validation.cpp, src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, and src/consensus/consensus.h.
rationale: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules on regtest to resolve known vulnerabilities including timewarp attacks, quadratic hashing DoS from legacy sigops, and 64-byte Merkle tree collisions. As a proposed soft fork, reviewer attention is needed to evaluate rule correctness and unblock community testing ahead of any mainnet deployment.
